name: perso-dubbing
description: Auto-dub videos into other languages with lip-sync via the Perso AI Dubbing API, plus voice/background audio separation and SRT subtitle extraction & translation (/srt). Handles single files, folders, URLs, oversized/long media (auto split & merge), multi-language output, and resume.

perso_api_key.title: Perso API key (optional)
perso_api_key.description: Optional: copy your Perso API key into the plugin local credential file at session start. Windows uses DPAPI; macOS/Linux use a plaintext file restricted to the current user. Leave blank to keep browser sign-in or existing credentials. An XP_API_KEY environment override still takes precedence. Clearing this option does not delete the local copy. Never paste a key into chat.
